newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end up at 23.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end up at 23.25 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed higher in a two-way interbank money market as banks began to fill their reserves on the first day of the new two-week reserve period, dealers said.
Overnight rates ended at 23.25 percent, up from 23.00 percent at the open and from Tuesday's end at 18.00 percent.
"Overnight rates firmed to 23.25 percent from 23.00 percent at the beginning," said Karoly Barath of Postabank. "Many banks fill their reserves," he said.
Despite the fact that there were many takers, the market was quite balanced due to good supply, dealers said.
Barath expected overnight rates to remain around current levels the rest of the week.
